name: Arcburn: Neon Combat Racing
summary:
The Night League races after dark: twelve cars, six cities, and nine powers you use with your own hands.

DRIVE IT LIKE IT'S REAL. Close your hands round the wheel and turn it. Pull it towards you to brake and kick the tail out into a drift; hold the slide for a burst of speed on the way out. Hands or controllers, seated, with comfort settings that keep your view level whatever the car does.

THROW, DON'T PRESS. Let go with one hand and the power in your rack floats into your palm. Throw it forward at whoev
